title: Circuit description length bound
statement: Let $a,k,C_w,c_w,n_b$ be natural numbers, and let $F$ be a family of directed acyclic Boolean circuits whose gates are well formed and have at most two inputs. Suppose every circuit in the family has size at most $a(n+1)^k$ on inputs of length $n$. Define $W(n)=C_w(n+1)^{c_w}$. Then the encoding length, plus one, of the circuit for input length $n_b+4W(n)+4+n$ is at most $\bigl(12a^2(n_b+4C_w+6)^{2k}+1\bigr)(n+1)^{2(c_w+1)k}$.
hypotheses_covered: a, k, Cw, cw, nb are natural numbers
F is a family of directed acyclic circuits
Every circuit in F is well formed and has gates of fan-in at most two
For every input length m, the circuit size is at most a(m+1)^k
